_comment: Battle loot. Cosmetic and flavour only in V1 — docs/06 is explicit that an item may never modify an attribute or a combat stat, because attributes must stay a pure reflection of real training. These entries therefore carry a name and a line of flavour and deliberately nothing else; battle.test.js asserts that no stat-shaped field ever appears here.

items.name: Ember Token
items.flavour: Still warm. It has been carried a long way.

items.name: Wyrm Scale
items.flavour: Heavier than it looks, and colder.

items.name: Lantern Glass
items.flavour: Cut from a lamp that burned all night on the path.

items.name: Quiet Stone
items.flavour: Worn smooth. Someone else carried it first.

items.name: Moss Charm
items.flavour: Grew over the thing it was tied to.

items.name: Cinder Nail
items.flavour: Pulled from a golem, and still hot.

items.name: Owl Feather
items.flavour: Found on the road. Nothing was watching.

items.name: Cap Spore
items.flavour: Violet, and faintly luminous in the dark.

items.name: Old Signet
items.flavour: The crest has worn away. The weight has not.
